text_block_list.text:
One day, Fine Motion was eating a meal at 
a ramen shop—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What a mellow, fragrant soy sauce flavor♪ 
As expected, the broth at "Kachiboshi" is 
truly in a league of its own desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. Now then, Captain. 
Let us proceed with our fandom activities!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Please leave your safety along the way to 
us. —So, what exactly is it that you will 
be supporting?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The ramen that has completely captivated 
my heart— I shall become a dedicated fan 
of this very shop, "Kachiboshi."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And by mastering the art of fandom, I will 
learn its psychology. To discover how the 
people of Ireland can enjoy supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, here is another. A four-leaf 
clover. That makes all 27 that we needed 
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, this completes it. The photo album 
dedicated to Kachiboshi's ramen. 
...However, why specifically this number?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
These represent Kachiboshi's "victories"— 
in other words, the number of awards their 
ramen has won.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Gracing the cover of the album will be 
their signature menu item, the "Special 
Soy Sauce." I shall decorate its borders 
with clovers, giving it a gorgeous 
embellishment desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I am still debating the finer points of 
the layout... Fufu, let us take our time 
contemplating it desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, Kachiboshi... the aroma of charred 
scallions— the chashu pork tenderly 
melting apart at the touch of 
chopsticks...!)

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
What a splendid performance...! It feels 
as though its gentle flavor is truly 
expressed in the music.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The harmony between the springy noodles 
and the soy sauce broth—that marriage is 
truly an art form, desu wa...!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
I could see it too—the intricately 
intertwined ramen! Such exquisite 
definition...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The more feelings I put into creating it, 
the deeper my understanding becomes. This 
joy is truly the greatest part of 
supporting one's favorite, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Eating ramen with such a fulfilled heart 
will surely make it taste even more 
exquisite. Shall we head over to 
Kachiboshi? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?! "Notice of Long-Term Closure"?! 
Oh dear, why so suddenly...?!

text_block_list.name: Kachiboshi Owner
text_block_list.text: —No good, this isn't the right flavor!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you alright...?! Whatever 
happened...?!

text_block_list.name: Kachiboshi Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry, did you hear that? The truth 
is... the soy sauce brewery we've been 
sourcing from went out of business...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What... Does that mean we can no longer 
eat Kachiboshi's ramen...?

text_block_list.name: Kachiboshi Owner
text_block_list.text:
...I won't let it end like that. I'll test 
every soy sauce across Japan—no, across 
the entire world—and bring that flavor 
back!

text_block_list.name: Kachiboshi Owner
text_block_list.text:
So that all our customers can slurp their 
ramen with a smile once again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Owner—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Ah. I can feel the pure passion of the 
one I support reaching me. Such fiery 
dedication... what true bliss—!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Owner. I—I will continue to support you 
from now on, too. Believing in the day we 
meet that flavor once again.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
I too feel the desire to support them... 
to support Kachiboshi. So this is what 
fandom is all about.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely. Thanks to this, I can also 
see what goal I ought to strive for, desu 
wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let us return to the academy. Just like 
the owner, I shall give it my absolute 
all, desu wa.

One day at a cafe, I spotted Fine Motion 
watching training footage.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it lacks impact. At this rate, it 
just looks like an ordinary training 
scene—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Do you have a moment? I was 
hoping you could be my subject.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to try all sorts of things to learn 
how to shoot video with a real sense of 
presence!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That sounds good. And perhaps sit-ups, 
back extensions, dancing, or parkour—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, forgive me! I was being far too 
demanding, wasn't I? But—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I really want to capture great footage, no 
matter what. In order to fire up the 
hearts of everyone watching!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, may I borrow that idea? A race, huh... 
Maybe I should ask someone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If so, someone exceptionally strong would 
be best. A nail-biting showdown really 
makes you want to cheer them on, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that gives me another thing to look 
forward to.
